messages.全部字段（包括后续新增字段）: All fields, including newly collected fields
messages.仅影响页面展示与分析选项；采集与原始数据保持完整，可随时恢复字段。: Applies to display and analysis choices. Collection and original data stay complete; fields can be restored at any time.
messages.请至少选择一个已有字段，或展示全部字段。: Select at least one existing field, or show all fields.
messages.条件检查已启用；满足条件时发送。: Condition checks are enabled; delivery occurs when the condition is met.
messages.条件触发报告按此频率检查；只有满足条件时才发送。通过 EnGenie 对话调整条: Conditional reports are checked at this frequency and sent only when their conditions are met. Edit the conditions in the EnGenie conversation.
messages.任一输出行满足条件时触发。: Trigger when any output row meets the condition.
messages.所有输出行满足条件时触发。: Trigger when all output rows meet the condition.
messages.首次满足时发送；条件解除后可再次触发。: Send when the condition first becomes true; re-arm after it clears.
messages.当前预览满足触发条件。: The current preview meets the trigger condition.
messages.当前预览未满足触发条件；不会发送。: The current preview does not meet the condition; nothing will be sent.
messages.当前数据无法确定触发条件；不会发送。: The condition cannot be determined from the current data; nothing will be sent.
messages.当前数据未满足触发条件，本次未发送。: The current data does not meet the condition; nothing was sent.
messages.大于或等于: is greater than or equal to
messages.小于或等于: is less than or equal to
messages.请选择有效的条件匹配方式和重复通知方式。: Choose a valid matching and repeat-notification policy.
messages.通知冷却时间需为0至525600分钟。: The notification cooldown must be between 0 and 525600 minutes.
messages.触发条件过多或嵌套过深。: There are too many trigger conditions or too many nested levels.
messages.每组触发条件需包含1至20项。: Each condition group must contain between 1 and 20 conditions.
messages.触发条件需引用一个报告输出字段或记录数。: A trigger condition must reference an output field or the output row count.
messages.触发条件引用了未知报告输出字段。: A trigger condition references an unknown report output field.
messages.缺失值判断只能用于报告字段，且不需要比较值。: Missing-value checks require an output field and do not accept a comparison value.
messages.触发条件的比较值必须是有限数值。: The trigger comparison value must be finite.
messages.记录数条件需使用非负数值。: Row-count conditions require a nonnegative number.
messages.大小比较需使用数值；请先用报告计算规则转换日期或文本。: Ordered comparisons require numbers. Convert dates or text with a report calculation first.
messages.条件触发报告需使用独立的检查频率或按需检查。: Conditional reports require an independent check schedule or manual checks.
messages.条件触发报告需要明确的触发条件。: A conditional report requires an explicit trigger condition.
messages.触发报告配置已变更或停用，本次发送已取消。: The conditional report was changed or paused; this send was cancelled.
messages.触发检查已取消，本次未发送。: The condition check was cancelled; nothing was sent.
messages.触发检查状态已变更，本次未发送。: The condition check state changed; nothing was sent.
messages.报告发送已取消，本次未发送。: Delivery was cancelled; nothing was sent.
messages.通过邮件还是 Teams 聊天或频道发送？: Send by email or to a Teams chat or channel?
